title: Aromatic Syrian Beetroot Soup
description: A jammy, glassy beetroot soup seasoned with cumin, coriander, and tahini, perfect for a high-protein energizing lunch.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Roast the quartered beetroot, drizzled with olive oil, for 45 minutes until tender and slightly caramelized.
Meanwhile, sauté diced onion and garlic in a saucepan over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the roasted beetroot to the saucepan and pour in the vegetable broth, bringing to a gentle simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and blend the soup until silky smooth using an immersion blender or regular blender.
Stir in tahini, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, sumac, salt, and pepper until fully incorporated.
Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salt or pepper if desired.
Ladle the soup into bowls, garnish with a swirl of tahini and a sprinkle of sumac if extra zing is desired.
